content_sections.heading: About IOL
content_sections.text: India Optel Limited is a Schedule B Central Public Sector Enterprise under the administrative jurisdiction of the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, with its registered office at OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun-248008. It has 3 production units: Ordnance Factory Chandigarh, Ordnance Factory Dehradun and Opto-Electronics Factory Dehradun. Its products include sights for T-90S (BHISHMA), Tank T-72 M1 (AJEYA) and ICV BMP-II (SARATH), along with artillery and surveillance sights, assault rifle and small arms sights, cables, the Commander Thermal Imager and periscopes. As on 31 March 2026, its authorized and paid up capital stood at Rs. 6500 Crores and Rs. 5958.64 Crores, with 04 regular employees at Board of Director level and 2275 employees on deemed deputation.

content_sections.heading: Job Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Chairman & Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the company, accountable to the Board of Directors and the Government of India, and responsible for its efficient functioning and for meeting its corporate objectives and performance parameters. Liaise with important customers and Central Government Authorities, particularly the Department of Defence Production and the Defence Research & Development Organization. Maintain close liaison with the three Service Headquarters on ongoing Defence projects, and develop further business in night vision and laser sighting devices. Liaise with State Government Authorities, heads of other Public Sector Undertakings, customers, collaborators, and commercial and financial institutions. Provide overall leadership on indigenization and import substitution, exports, business development and marketing, defence production, modernization, R&D and innovation.

content_sections.heading: IOL Chairman & Managing Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted on the date of occurrence of vacancy, and the age of superannuation is 60 years. The same limits apply to internal candidates and others. The applicant should be an Engineering Graduate/ Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant/ Post Graduate/Graduate with MBA/ PGDIM from a leading institute. The applicant should meet one of these two requirements: Cumulative experience/exposure for at least 5 years during the last 10 years in Finance, Business Development, Production, Operations, Marketing, Project Management or Research & Development in an Industry of repute. Cumulative 5 years of experience in HR/IR/Personnel Management, along with at least 3 years experience during the last 10 years in any of the above core areas. Applicants with experience in the Electronics/Opto-Electronics/Instrumentation/Communication Industry will be preferred. On both the date of application and the date of interview, the applicant must be employed in a regular capacity, not a contractual or ad-hoc one, in one of the following: A Central Public Sector Enterprise, including as a full-time functional Director on its Board. Central Government Group 'A' service, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, or a Public Sector bank, Financial Institution or Autonomous Body. A State Public Sector Enterprise with annual turnover of Rs 750 Crore or more. A Private Sector Company, Joint Venture or National or State Level Cooperative Federation with annual turnover of Rs. 750 crore or more. The minimum service required in the eligible scale is one year for internal candidates and two years for others as on the date of vacancy. Eligible officers of the Indian Ordnance Factories Services are treated as internal candidates. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

faq.question: Q1. Can a person on contract apply for the IOL CMD post?
faq.answer: No. The applicant must be employed in a regular capacity on both the date of application and the date of interview, and contractual or ad-hoc employment does not qualify.

faq.question: Q2. Who counts as an internal candidate?
faq.answer: Eligible officers of the Indian Ordnance Factories Services are considered internal candidates. They need one year of service in the eligible scale, against two years for others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum company turnover for private sector applicants?
faq.answer: The company must have an annual turnover of Rs. 750 crore or more, and the applicant must be working at Board level. The same turnover limit applies to State Public Sector Enterprises.

faq.question: Q4. How many years of experience are needed?
faq.answer: At least 5 years during the last 10 years in a core area such as Finance, Production, Marketing or Research & Development. Those with 5 years in HR/IR/Personnel Management also need at least 3 years in a core area during the last 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It runs for 5 years from joining, unless superannuation or further orders end it earlier.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if a selected candidate refuses to join?
faq.answer: A candidate who conveys unwillingness after the interview, or after the offer of appointment, is debarred for two years from being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE. For CPSE candidates, the bar covers CPSEs other than their own. The two years run from the date of the interview or of the offer, and no request for relaxation would be entertained.

faq.question: Q7. How many times can I appear in selection meetings?
faq.answer: You may apply any number of times in a calendar year but can appear in only 03 selection meetings. Being shortlisted and remaining absent counts as one of the three.

faq.question: Q8. How much time do nodal officers get to verify applications?
faq.answer: Nodal officers of CPSEs, Ministries and Departments get 9 days for verification. All applications are to be forwarded to DDP/MoD within 30 days from the date of advertisement.
